## Introduction

In this post, I will use Python to explore the Palmer Penguins dataset and compare penguin measurements among the three species.

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.


## Exploring the data

```{python}
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import pandas as pd

penguins = load_penguins()

penguins_clean = penguins[["species", "body_mass_g"]].dropna()

penguins_clean
```

## Average body mass by species

```{python}
average_mass = (
    penguins_clean
    .groupby("species", as_index=False)
    ["body_mass_g"]
    .mean()
)

average_mass
```

## Body mass comparison

```{python}
#| label: fig-python-body-mass
#| fig-cap: "Average body mass of Palmer Penguins by species."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.bar(
    average_mass["species"],
    average_mass["body_mass_g"]
)

plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Average body mass (g)")
plt.show()
```

## Findings

The results show that Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass. Adelie and Chinstrap penguins have similar average body masses, while Gentoo penguins are noticeably heavier.
